name: openmrs-healthcare-automation
description: Playwright UI + Postman/Newman API automation suite for the OpenMRS O3 healthcare platform
author: Abinaya Moorthy

scripts.api:test: newman run postman/OpenMRS-REST-API-Suite.postman_collection.json -e postman/OpenMRS-Environment.postman_environment.json --reporters cli,htmlextra,json --reporter-htmlextra-export newman/openmrs-api-report.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "OpenMRS REST API Suite" --reporter-htmlextra-browserTitle "OpenMRS API Report" --reporter-json-export newman/openmrs-api-report.json --delay-request 300
scripts.api:report: newman run postman/OpenMRS-REST-API-Suite.postman_collection.json -e postman/OpenMRS-Environment.postman_environment.json --reporters htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export newman/openmrs-api-report.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "OpenMRS REST API Suite" --delay-request 300 --suppress-exit-code
